items.title: Firm that lets you rent out your idle Mac for AI inference workloads warns of plummeting token costs
items.description: Mac users sharing their compute for AI inference are seeing declining revenues as token prices continue to drop, with Anthropic token falling 77% in under five months.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Darkbloom, a decentralized AI inference network that aggregates and sells spare compute capacity from Macs, told its members to expect revenues to fall as token prices continue to drop. According to The Register, the price per million tokens for Anthropic dropped by 77% in under five months, falling to $0.62 in October 2026 from $2.65 in May.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI shortages (Image credit: Nvidia)AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supplyDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleChip scarcity assaults auto industry amid the worsening Nexperia and DRAM crisisThe custom AI ASIC state of play“Data centers have become cheaper. Output per NVIDIA cluster is up ~20x this year, and their margins are wide enough to cut prices 90 percent and still profit at 50 percent,” said Kydo, a researcher from Eigen Labs, the developer of the compute platform. “The market caught up to our price. We could go lower, but then most of you would earn even less [than] nothing.”It’s estimated that someone running an M5 Pro Mac Mini with 64GB of Unified Memory could earn as much as $192 per month. This is the best-case scenario, though; the median earnings of the top 50 operators on Darkbloom’s leaderboard are about $159.86 per month. This translates to about $5.26 daily or $1,918.50 annually. However, if we account for Anthropic’s 77% token price drop, earnings will fall to a measly $36.77 per month, or about $1.23 per day.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: AI token prices are falling so fast that they've even outpaced Moore’s Law, with some reports saying AI is becoming 50% cheaper every quarter and up to 13 times more affordable every year. News of companies blowing through their annual AI budgets in months has less to do with per-token price and more with the number of tokens, as agentic AI use outpaces token price drops. Aside from that, OpenRouter, Darkbloom’s primary client, has started prioritizing decode speed, quantization, and prefill speed, putting users without a top-of-the-line Max or Ultra Apple chip at a disadvantage.Despite that, Darkbloom says it will not sit idly by and let some users lose out because of these changes. The network is analyzing model demand to advise members on which models are in higher demand right now. It’s also looking at other kinds of workload beyond inference, including distributed CI/CD jobs, improving network performance to better compete against other computer providers/aggregators, and finding other clients outside of OpenRouter. items.titleZh: 让你出租闲置 Mac 用于 AI 推理负载的公司警告称 token 成本将暴跌
items.descriptionZh:
Darkbloom是一家去中心化AI推理网络，通过聚合并出售Mac的闲置算力来获取收入。该公司近日告知成员，随着代币（token）价格持续下跌，预期收入将下降。据The Register报道，Anthropic每百万token的价格在不到五个月内下跌77%，从2026年5月的2.65美元降至2026年10月的0.62美元。

该网络由Eigen Labs开发。Eigen Labs研究员Kydo表示，数据中心已经变得更便宜，英伟达集群的产出今年提升约20倍，其利润率足以支撑价格下调90%后仍保持50%的盈利水平。他称“市场已经追上了我们的价格。我们可以把价格降得更低，但那样你们大多数人赚到的甚至还不如‘什么都不赚’”。这反映出，去中心化消费级算力网络正面临集中式AI数据中心规模经济带来的直接价格竞争压力。

从收益参数看，Darkbloom给出的估算显示，运行一台配备64GB统一内存的M5 Pro Mac Mini，理论最高月收入可达192美元；但这是最佳情形。Darkbloom排行榜前50名运营者的收入中位数约为每月159.86美元，折合约每天5.26美元、每年1918.50美元。若计入Anthropic token价格77%的降幅，月收入将降至约36.77美元，折合每天约1.23美元。这表明，在token单价快速下滑时，依靠消费级Mac提供推理算力的经济性会显著恶化。

技术层面，Darkbloom的核心模式是将分散的Mac设备统一内存和闲置计算能力聚合为推理资源，再向OpenRouter等客户出售推理服务。其创新点在于利用消费级硬件而非专用数据中心GPU集群参与AI推理供给，并通过网络调度和需求分析来匹配模型负载。不过，Darkbloom的主要客户OpenRouter已开始优先考虑解码速度、量化和预填充速度，这使没有苹果Max或Ultra顶级芯片的用户处于劣势，意味着网络对硬件性能的要求正在提高。

行业趋势方面，AI token价格下降速度甚至超过摩尔定律。有报告称，AI成本每季度约下降50%，每年最多可便宜13倍。企业年度AI预算在几个月内耗尽，主要原因并非每token单价，而是token使用总量快速膨胀，尤其是智能体式AI（agentic AI）的采用速度超过了token价格下降速度。

面对收入压力，Darkbloom表示不会坐视部分用户因变化而受损。该网络正在分析模型需求，指导成员运行当前需求更高的模型；同时探索推理之外的工作负载，包括分布式CI/CD任务，并改善网络性能以更好与其他计算提供商和聚合商竞争，以及寻找OpenRouter之外的客户。整体来看，这一案例揭示了去中心化AI推理网络的商业逻辑：在token价格快速下跌和集中式数据中心效率飙升的背景下，聚合闲置Mac算力虽能降低参与门槛并实现设备货币化，但其收益空间正被持续压缩，未来需要通过负载多元化、需求匹配和网络性能优化来维持竞争力。

items.title: Intel shifts production capacity from consumer to server CPUs in face of 'unprecedented' AI demand
items.description: Intel is expanding chipmaking and advanced packaging capacity across the U.S., Ireland, and Malaysia to meet surging AI-driven demand for data center CPUs amid shrinking PC market and persistent supply constraints.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Although the consumer PC market is shrinking and will continue to shrink in the coming quarters, Intel is confident that the overwhelming demand from the AI industry for everything that can compute or store data will offset declines in the client space. To that end, the company is reallocating some of its capacity from client to data center CPUs, expanding its Fab 24 in Ireland to make more Xeons, has begun equipment installation into Fab 62 in Arizona ahead of schedule and vows to make 18A chips there, and is expanding its advanced packaging capacity in New Mexico and Malaysia.Go deeper with TH Premium: CPU (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Intel VP Robert Hallock sets Nova Lake expectations, teases return to Raptor Lake for DDR4 platformsCPU scaling with DLSSIntel's one-two punch plan in desktop CPUs is taking shapeBenchmarking AMD's BC-250, offering Steam Machine-like performance at half the priceAMD splits Zen 7 into three EPYC families for 2028 and starts selling server CPUs by the agent "The industry continues to navigate one of the most significant supply shortages in history, driven by the unprecedented demand for Super Intelligence," said Lip-Bu Tan, chief executive of Intel, during the company's earnings call. "Against this backdrop, I am pleased by the progress we made growing our server supply in Q3. I am mindful about the ongoing challenges we face in the future quarters to keep pace with server demand."More Intel 3-based XeonsIntel's manufacturing expansion comes as demand for server processors continues to exceed supply despite substantial production increases over the next several quarters. The company's Data Center and AI (DCAI) business generated $7.3 billion in revenue in the third quarter of 2026, up 17% sequentially and nearly 80% year-over-year. Intel expects demand for data center CPUs to remain strong in 2027 – 2028 as AI infrastructure operators deploy more CPU-intensive agentic and inference workloads.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: To meet demand for Xeon CPUs in the coming years, one of Intel's immediate priorities is to increase output of Xeon 6 'Granite Rapids' processors, which are made using its Intel 3 process technology. The company recently began expanding production capacity at its Fab 24 manufacturing complex near Leixlip, Ireland, but this capacity will only come online by the end of 2027, unless the move can be accelerated.To further increase its Intel 3 capacity, Intel plans to convert some manufacturing resources at its Oregon facilities from Intel 18A to Intel 3. These resources were originally intended to manufacture Panther Lake client processors, but weaker PC demand has allowed Intel to prioritize higher-demand data center products. The company expects the additional Intel 3 capacity in Oregon to enter production in the second half of 2027. You may like Nvidia is bankrolling AI accelerator supply chain buildout to reserve production capacity Desktop CPU shipments crater 20% amid high component costs, but AMD gains record share despite 'ugly' desktop processor market Intel confirms Nova Lake CPUs will use advanced 18A-P node, more details at CES "What we are taking offline to put Intel 3 into Oregon is 18A wafers, which we are generally going to build Panther Lake products," said Dave Zinsner, chief financial officer of Intel. "We see the opportunity with some of that capacity freed up to go produce more data center wafers."Granite Rapids has already become Intel's fastest ramping server processor family, but demand continues to exceed available supply, according to the company's management. Intel is also improving manufacturing yields and reducing production cycle times to extract more usable processors from its existing capacity. According to the company, Intel 3 manufacturing costs have declined by approximately 15% since the first quarter of 2026.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsPrepping for Diamond Rapids, Nova LakeIntel is also accelerating the expansion of its leading-edge manufacturing operations in Arizona. The company is ramping Intel 18A production at Fab 52 and is accelerating equipment installation into the adjacent Fab 62, which is set to become the company's second high-volume manufacturing facility for 18A, 18A-P, and derivative process technologies.These investments will support future Intel 18A/18A-P-based products, including server CPUs, although the company has not disclosed the precise allocation of manufacturing capacity between client and data center products at the facility. While the latter is natural, Intel said during the conference call that it expects to win some market share in the client space with its Core Ultra 400-series 'Nova Lake' CPUs, which will require the company to produce these parts in high volumes.To support its capacity expansion, Intel aggressively procured new tools in the third quarter. What to read next Intel reportedly set to hike CPU prices by 10% ahead of 'major annual product' launch in March 2027 Deadly Intel Fab 28 explosion causes two-week shutdown, to cost $600 million and severely disrupt server chip manufacturing for six months ASML struggling to keep up with demand for chipmaking equipment as AI spending continues to boom Not only wafersWhile expanding production of Intel 3 and Intel 18A/18A-P wafers is a must to increase output of data center CPUs, producing more wafers will not necessarily solve Intel's supply problems. The company also faces shortages of advanced organic substrates required to package its multi-chiplet processors (or rather system-in-packages, or SiPs?) that rely on EMIB and/or Foveros 3D packaging technologies. Intel has been working with substrate suppliers to expand their production capacity and expects approximately 40% additional substrate capacity to become available in the second half of 2027."We are not only constrained on the wafer side, we are also constrained on the substrate side," Zinsner said. "So, it is important we get the substrate piece of this ramped up to be able to meet the demand."In addition, Intel is expanding its advanced packaging operations in New Mexico and Malaysia to support growing demand from internal product groups and external customers. The company already uses its EMIB technology to connect multiple compute dies in Granite Rapids processors, while its newer Clearwater Forest Xeons combine EMIB with Foveros Direct 3D and hybrid bonding to stack Intel 18A compute dies on Intel 3 base dies. Additional packaging capacity will be essential as Intel increases production of these processors and introduces more complex multi-die products as well as assembles advanced system-in-packages using EMIB, EMIB-T, Foveros 3D, and other technologies for external clients."On Advanced Packaging, we are pleased by the progress we are making with EMIB and EMIB-T for our internal products," Tan said. "Both continue to see significant external customer traction as well. We continue to improve on execution, working with our supply chain to secure the capacity to meet the needs of our Advanced Packaging customers. We are also seeing robust progress in the readiness of Hybrid Bonding Interconnect (HBI), which is an enabler of 3D chip stacking for our upcoming server products."Capital neededIntel's expansions will require substantial capital. Intel expects its capital expenditure (CapEx) budget to reach approximately $20 billion in 2026 and increase significantly in 2027 (though it did not reveal any firm numbers). The company said firm purchase orders to semiconductor equipment suppliers increased by nearly 40% sequentially as it secured tools for its manufacturing expansion. Intel is also evaluating opportunities to accelerate construction of its semiconductor manufacturing complex in Ohio, where the first major structural truss was recently installed."We have made good progress securing the equipment required to support our growth plans with firm purchase orders to equipment suppliers increasing nearly 40% sequentially," Zinsner said. "We are also accelerating clean room build-outs, including Fab 62 in Arizona and exploring opportunities to accelerate in Ohio.Yet Intel's capacity expansion will take time to produce results. New equipment must be installed and qualified, additional wafers must pass through lengthy manufacturing cycles, and substrate suppliers must increase their output (which will likely require them to procure new tools and install them) before Intel can ship more finished processors. Consequently, the company expects supply constraints to remain particularly severe during the first half of 2027, even as the client PC market is set to continue contracting.Nevertheless, Intel expects its data center business to continue growing and believes that additional manufacturing capacity, higher yields, and improved substrate availability will enable it to capitalize on demand for AI infrastructure in the second half of 2027 and beyond. items.author: Anton Shilov
items.titleZh: 面对“前所未有的”AI需求，英特尔将产能从消费级CPU转向服务器CPU
items.descriptionZh:
尽管消费级PC市场正在萎缩，且预计未来几个季度仍将收缩，Intel正把部分产能从客户端产品转向数据中心CPU，以应对AI行业对“一切可计算或存储数据”能力的压倒性需求。Intel CEO陈立武（Lip-Bu Tan）在财报电话会上表示，行业正经历历史上最严重的供应短缺之一，背后是“超级智能”需求空前高涨；公司对第三季度服务器供应增长感到满意，但也清楚未来几个季度要跟上服务器需求仍面临挑战。Intel数据中心与AI业务（DCAI）2026年第三季度营收为73亿美元，环比增长17%，同比增长近80%。公司预计，随着AI基础设施运营商部署更多CPU密集型的智能体（agentic）和推理工作负载，2027至2028年数据中心CPU需求仍将强劲。

为增加Xeon供应，Intel的近期重点是扩大基于Intel 3制程的Xeon 6“Granite Rapids”处理器产量。Granite Rapids已成为Intel爬坡最快的服务器处理器家族，但需求仍超过供应。公司已开始扩建爱尔兰Leixlip附近的Fab 24制造园区，但新增产能要到2027年底才能上线，除非能够加速。为进一步增加Intel 3产能，Intel计划把俄勒冈工厂部分原本用于Intel 18A的资源转为Intel 3；这些资源原计划生产Panther Lake客户端处理器，但PC需求疲软使Intel可以优先满足需求更高的数据中心产品。俄勒冈新增Intel 3产能预计2027年下半年投产。CFO Dave Zinsner表示，被腾出用于俄勒冈Intel 3产能的是原本生产Panther Lake的18A晶圆产能。Intel还通过提升良率和缩短生产周期来从现有产能中挤出更多可用处理器；自2026年第一季度以来，Intel 3制造成本已下降约15%。

先进制程扩产方面，Intel正在亚利桑那Fab 52爬坡Intel 18A生产，并加速相邻Fab 62的设备安装。Fab 62将成为Intel第二个高量产18A、18A-P及衍生制程技术的基地，支持包括未来服务器CPU在内的18A/18A-P产品，但公司未披露该厂客户端与数据中心产品的具体产能分配。Intel还表示，希望借助Core Ultra 400系列“Nova Lake”CPU在客户端市场赢得部分份额，这需要高量产支持。为支撑扩产，Intel第三季度大举采购新设备；公司预计2026年资本开支约200亿美元，2027年将显著增加，但未公布具体数字。对半导体设备供应商的确定采购订单环比增长近40%，公司还在评估加速俄亥俄州半导体制造园区建设的机会。

扩产并不只受晶圆产能限制。Intel多芯片小芯片处理器或系统级封装（SiP）依赖EMIB和/或Foveros 3D封装技术，需要先进有机基板。Zinsner称，公司不仅受晶圆端约束，也受基板端约束，因此提升基板供应很重要。Intel正与基板供应商合作扩产，预计2027年下半年将新增约40%基板产能。同时，Intel正在新墨西哥和马来西亚扩大先进封装业务，以支持内部产品团队和外部客户增长。Granite Rapids已使用EMIB连接多个计算die；较新的Clearwater Forest Xeon则把EMIB与Foveros Direct 3D和混合键合结合，将Intel 18A计算die堆叠在Intel 3基础die上。随着Intel提高这些处理器产量、推出更复杂的多die产品，并为外部客户组装基于EMIB、EMIB-T、Foveros 3D等技术的先进系统级封装，额外封装产能至关重要。陈立武表示，EMIB和EMIB-T在内部产品上进展良好，对外部客户也继续保持显著吸引力；混合键合互连（HBI）的准备程度也稳步推进，这是未来服务器产品实现3D芯片堆叠的关键使能技术。

这些扩产需要大量资本，也需要时间才能产生结果：新设备必须安装和验证，新增晶圆要经过漫长制造周期，基板供应商也需采购和安装新设备才能提高产出。因此，Intel预计2027年上半年供应约束仍将特别严重，即使客户端PC市场继续收缩。不过，Intel仍预计数据中心业务将继续增长，并认为新增制造产能、更高良率和基板供应改善，将使其在2027年下半年及以后更好地把握AI基础设施需求。

items.title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
items.description:
Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, the company announced on its Chinese newsroom website, as reported by MacRumors. The Apple Intelligence features will be available first in an iOS 27.3 beta that's set to launch on November 4th, with a full iOS 27.3 release scheduled for December.
This launch doesn't bring the new Siri AI to China. Instead, Apple is launching several of its earlier Apple Intelligence features like notification summaries, real-time translation, rewriting and proofreading tools, visual intelligence, and removing objects from photos. Read the full story at The Verge.
items.content: Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, the company announced on its Chinese newsroom website, as reported by MacRumors. The Apple Intelligence features will be available first in an iOS 27.3 beta that’s set to launch on November 4th, with a full iOS 27.3 release scheduled for December.This launch doesn’t bring the new Siri AI to China. Instead, Apple is launching several of its earlier Apple Intelligence features like notification summaries, real-time translation, rewriting and proofreading tools, visual intelligence, and removing objects from photos. Apple also says it has worked with Ailbaba to add support for its Qwen chatbot in some experiences, which sounds similar to iOS’s integration with OpenAI’s ChatGPT that launched in 2024.Apple Intelligence was approved in China in July, which signalled that the launch of the AI tools was getting near. Apple trained its own LLM specifically for China, Reuters reported in August.
items.author: Jay Peters
items.descriptionZh:
苹果已在其中国官网新闻室宣布，Apple Intelligence 将随 iOS 27.3 登陆中国。据 MacRumors 报道，首批 Apple Intelligence 功能会先在计划于 11 月 4 日发布的 iOS 27.3 测试版中提供，正式版 iOS 27.3 则计划于 12 月推出。此次上线并不包含新的 Siri AI，而是先落地苹果此前已推出的一组 Apple Intelligence 功能，包括通知摘要、实时翻译、改写与校对工具、视觉智能，以及从照片中移除物体等。

在中国版 Apple Intelligence 的落地方案上，苹果表示已与阿里巴巴合作，在某些体验中加入对其通义千问（Qwen）聊天机器人的支持。这一集成方式听起来类似 iOS 在 2024 年与 OpenAI ChatGPT 的整合，即由本地合作伙伴的大模型为部分 AI 体验提供能力支持。原文未具体说明 Qwen 接入哪些功能、调用边界如何，也未披露模型规模、响应时延、准确率等性能参数，因此目前无法进行具体的量化对比。可确认的对比主要是功能范围：中国首发版本覆盖较早一批 Apple Intelligence 能力，但不包含新的 Siri AI；Qwen 的集成定位则与 ChatGPT 在 iOS 中的合作模式相似。

背景方面，Apple Intelligence 已于今年 7 月在中国获批，这被视为相关 AI 工具临近上线的信号。路透社 8 月报道称，苹果还专门为中国训练了自有大语言模型。结合这两点看，中国版 Apple Intelligence 可能采取“自研本地模型＋本地合作伙伴模型”的组合路线：一方面通过专门训练的自有 LLM 适配中国市场，另一方面引入阿里 Qwen 为部分体验补充大模型能力。这种安排既延续 Apple Intelligence 端侧与云端协同的总体思路，也体现出针对中国监管环境和本地生态进行适配的策略。其创新点更多在于落地与合规路径，而非全新功能形态：先上线通知摘要、翻译、写作辅助、视觉识别和图像编辑等成熟度较高的功能，暂缓新 Siri AI，有助于降低初期合规与体验风险。

从应用场景看，这批功能可覆盖通知信息降噪、跨语言沟通、文本改写与校对、视觉信息理解以及照片对象移除等日常需求，提升 iPhone 在中国市场的 AI 可用性和本土化体验。技术影响上，苹果专门为中国训练 LLM 并与阿里 Qwen 合作，意味着国际终端厂商在华落地生成式 AI 时，可能更普遍采用本地模型与本地生态合作并行的模式。不过，苹果尚未公布具体支持机型、完整功能清单、Qwen 的具体接入范围以及新 Siri AI 后续入华时间表，相关性能与体验表现仍需等待测试版和正式版上线后验证。

items.title: Sam Altman says it’s better for RAM to be in a data center than on your desk
items.description:
Asked about supply chain shortages, like the ongoing RAM shortage, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in an interview that it's "terrible" to have RAM in personal PCs instead of data centers. During his appearance on the Cheeky Pint podcast, where he also commented on AI's impact on math, Altman said:
"A lot of people want local inference. And somehow, they assume that the problem is solved now because we are going to have open-source models, we're going to be able to run them on our computers, and so we're not going to need all the stuff in the data center.
But from a global allocation perspective, actually, it's quite terrible to have everybo …

Read the full story at The Verge.
items.content: Asked about supply chain shortages, like the ongoing RAM shortage, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in an interview that it’s “terrible” to have RAM in personal PCs instead of data centers. During his appearance on the Cheeky Pint podcast, where he also commented on AI’s impact on math, Altman said:“A lot of people want local inference. And somehow, they assume that the problem is solved now because we are going to have open-source models, we’re going to be able to run them on our computers, and so we’re not going to need all the stuff in the data center.But from a global allocation perspective, actually, it’s quite terrible to have everybody have a bunch of the world’s limited supply of DRAM sitting in their own computer and being used five percent of the time.You want maximum utilization in the cloud if you’re trying to deal with this very supply constrained environment. And somehow everyone’s— many people’s intuition is the opposite of that.”Whether Altman meant your gaming PC or developers working with something like the Surface RTX Spark Dev Box or the new touchscreen MacBook Pro, the outcome is the same. Right now, memory companies Samsung and SK Hynix have long term deals with cloud service operators and projects like OpenAI’s Stargate that have reserved much of the world’s RAM output over the next few years. And the billions they’re willing to lay out for chips is why the laptops, phones, and other tech you use are getting more expensive right now.
items.author: Stevie Bonifield
items.titleZh: 萨姆·奥尔特曼表示，内存放在数据中心比放在你的桌面上更好。
items.descriptionZh:
OpenAI CEO萨姆·奥尔特曼在参加Cheeky Pint播客时，被问及供应链短缺（包括持续的内存短缺）问题。他表示，把RAM放在个人PC里而不是数据中心是“糟糕的”。在播客中，他还谈到AI对数学的影响。奥尔特曼说：“很多人想要本地推理。不知何故，他们假设问题已经解决，因为我们将拥有开源模型，能够在自己电脑上运行，因此不再需要数据中心里的所有东西。但从全球分配的角度看，让每个人把世界上有限的DRAM供应中的一部分放在自己电脑里，而且只使用5%的时间，实际上相当糟糕。如果你要应对这种供应非常受限的环境，你希望云端实现最大利用率。而不知何故，每个人——很多人的直觉却相反。”

无论奥尔特曼指的是游戏PC，还是开发者使用的Surface RTX Spark Dev Box或新款触摸屏MacBook Pro等设备，结果都一样。目前，内存厂商三星和SK海力士已与云服务运营商以及OpenAI的Stargate等项目签订长期协议，预留了未来几年全球大部分RAM产出。他们愿意为芯片投入数十亿美元，这也是当前笔记本电脑、手机和其他科技产品变得越来越贵的原因。

从技术路线看，这一表态涉及本地推理与云端推理的权衡。本地推理指在个人电脑、手机或开发设备上直接运行开源模型，优点是隐私、低延迟和离线可用；但在内存供应紧张的背景下，每台设备都要配备大量DRAM，而实际使用率可能只有5%，会造成全球稀缺内存资源的低效分散。云端推理则把模型运行集中在数据中心，通过集中调度提高GPU、内存和存储的利用率，在供应受限时更有利于最大化有限DRAM的产出效率。奥尔特曼的观点并非否定本地推理，而是强调从全球资源分配看，把大量内存放在使用率很低的个人设备上并不合理。

原文没有给出具体性能参数或跑分对比，但提供了几个关键量化信息：个人设备中的DRAM可能仅被使用5%的时间；三星和SK海力士的长期协议覆盖未来几年全球大部分RAM产出；云厂商和Stargate等项目愿意投入数十亿美元锁定芯片产能。这些因素共同导致消费电子成本上升。其影响在于，AI推理需求增长正在重塑内存供应链：云服务商和大型AI项目优先获得产能，个人PC、手机等终端面临更贵的内存和更高的本地AI硬件门槛。应用场景上，云端推理适合大规模模型服务和供应紧张环境下的资源集中利用；本地推理仍适合隐私敏感、离线或低延迟场景，但需要权衡内存成本与利用率。

history.title: Firm that lets you rent out your idle Mac for AI inference workloads warns of plummeting token costs
history.description: Mac users sharing their compute for AI inference are seeing declining revenues as token prices continue to drop, with Anthropic token falling 77% in under five months.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Darkbloom, a decentralized AI inference network that aggregates and sells spare compute capacity from Macs, told its members to expect revenues to fall as token prices continue to drop. According to The Register, the price per million tokens for Anthropic dropped by 77% in under five months, falling to $0.62 in October 2026 from $2.65 in May.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI shortages (Image credit: Nvidia)AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supplyDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleChip scarcity assaults auto industry amid the worsening Nexperia and DRAM crisisThe custom AI ASIC state of play“Data centers have become cheaper. Output per NVIDIA cluster is up ~20x this year, and their margins are wide enough to cut prices 90 percent and still profit at 50 percent,” said Kydo, a researcher from Eigen Labs, the developer of the compute platform. “The market caught up to our price. We could go lower, but then most of you would earn even less [than] nothing.”It’s estimated that someone running an M5 Pro Mac Mini with 64GB of Unified Memory could earn as much as $192 per month. This is the best-case scenario, though; the median earnings of the top 50 operators on Darkbloom’s leaderboard are about $159.86 per month. This translates to about $5.26 daily or $1,918.50 annually. However, if we account for Anthropic’s 77% token price drop, earnings will fall to a measly $36.77 per month, or about $1.23 per day.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: AI token prices are falling so fast that they've even outpaced Moore’s Law, with some reports saying AI is becoming 50% cheaper every quarter and up to 13 times more affordable every year. News of companies blowing through their annual AI budgets in months has less to do with per-token price and more with the number of tokens, as agentic AI use outpaces token price drops. Aside from that, OpenRouter, Darkbloom’s primary client, has started prioritizing decode speed, quantization, and prefill speed, putting users without a top-of-the-line Max or Ultra Apple chip at a disadvantage.Despite that, Darkbloom says it will not sit idly by and let some users lose out because of these changes. The network is analyzing model demand to advise members on which models are in higher demand right now. It’s also looking at other kinds of workload beyond inference, including distributed CI/CD jobs, improving network performance to better compete against other computer providers/aggregators, and finding other clients outside of OpenRouter. history.author: Jowi Morales
history.titleZh: 让你出租闲置 Mac 用于 AI 推理负载的公司警告称 token 成本将暴跌
history.descriptionZh:
Darkbloom是一家去中心化AI推理网络，通过聚合并出售Mac的闲置算力来获取收入。该公司近日告知成员，随着代币（token）价格持续下跌，预期收入将下降。据The Register报道，Anthropic每百万token的价格在不到五个月内下跌77%，从2026年5月的2.65美元降至2026年10月的0.62美元。

该网络由Eigen Labs开发。Eigen Labs研究员Kydo表示，数据中心已经变得更便宜，英伟达集群的产出今年提升约20倍，其利润率足以支撑价格下调90%后仍保持50%的盈利水平。他称“市场已经追上了我们的价格。我们可以把价格降得更低，但那样你们大多数人赚到的甚至还不如‘什么都不赚’”。这反映出，去中心化消费级算力网络正面临集中式AI数据中心规模经济带来的直接价格竞争压力。

从收益参数看，Darkbloom给出的估算显示，运行一台配备64GB统一内存的M5 Pro Mac Mini，理论最高月收入可达192美元；但这是最佳情形。Darkbloom排行榜前50名运营者的收入中位数约为每月159.86美元，折合约每天5.26美元、每年1918.50美元。若计入Anthropic token价格77%的降幅，月收入将降至约36.77美元，折合每天约1.23美元。这表明，在token单价快速下滑时，依靠消费级Mac提供推理算力的经济性会显著恶化。

技术层面，Darkbloom的核心模式是将分散的Mac设备统一内存和闲置计算能力聚合为推理资源，再向OpenRouter等客户出售推理服务。其创新点在于利用消费级硬件而非专用数据中心GPU集群参与AI推理供给，并通过网络调度和需求分析来匹配模型负载。不过，Darkbloom的主要客户OpenRouter已开始优先考虑解码速度、量化和预填充速度，这使没有苹果Max或Ultra顶级芯片的用户处于劣势，意味着网络对硬件性能的要求正在提高。

行业趋势方面，AI token价格下降速度甚至超过摩尔定律。有报告称，AI成本每季度约下降50%，每年最多可便宜13倍。企业年度AI预算在几个月内耗尽，主要原因并非每token单价，而是token使用总量快速膨胀，尤其是智能体式AI（agentic AI）的采用速度超过了token价格下降速度。

面对收入压力，Darkbloom表示不会坐视部分用户因变化而受损。该网络正在分析模型需求，指导成员运行当前需求更高的模型；同时探索推理之外的工作负载，包括分布式CI/CD任务，并改善网络性能以更好与其他计算提供商和聚合商竞争，以及寻找OpenRouter之外的客户。整体来看，这一案例揭示了去中心化AI推理网络的商业逻辑：在token价格快速下跌和集中式数据中心效率飙升的背景下，聚合闲置Mac算力虽能降低参与门槛并实现设备货币化，但其收益空间正被持续压缩，未来需要通过负载多元化、需求匹配和网络性能优化来维持竞争力。

history.title: Intel shifts production capacity from consumer to server CPUs in face of 'unprecedented' AI demand
history.description: Intel is expanding chipmaking and advanced packaging capacity across the U.S., Ireland, and Malaysia to meet surging AI-driven demand for data center CPUs amid shrinking PC market and persistent supply constraints.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Although the consumer PC market is shrinking and will continue to shrink in the coming quarters, Intel is confident that the overwhelming demand from the AI industry for everything that can compute or store data will offset declines in the client space. To that end, the company is reallocating some of its capacity from client to data center CPUs, expanding its Fab 24 in Ireland to make more Xeons, has begun equipment installation into Fab 62 in Arizona ahead of schedule and vows to make 18A chips there, and is expanding its advanced packaging capacity in New Mexico and Malaysia.Go deeper with TH Premium: CPU (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Intel VP Robert Hallock sets Nova Lake expectations, teases return to Raptor Lake for DDR4 platformsCPU scaling with DLSSIntel's one-two punch plan in desktop CPUs is taking shapeBenchmarking AMD's BC-250, offering Steam Machine-like performance at half the priceAMD splits Zen 7 into three EPYC families for 2028 and starts selling server CPUs by the agent "The industry continues to navigate one of the most significant supply shortages in history, driven by the unprecedented demand for Super Intelligence," said Lip-Bu Tan, chief executive of Intel, during the company's earnings call. "Against this backdrop, I am pleased by the progress we made growing our server supply in Q3. I am mindful about the ongoing challenges we face in the future quarters to keep pace with server demand."More Intel 3-based XeonsIntel's manufacturing expansion comes as demand for server processors continues to exceed supply despite substantial production increases over the next several quarters. The company's Data Center and AI (DCAI) business generated $7.3 billion in revenue in the third quarter of 2026, up 17% sequentially and nearly 80% year-over-year. Intel expects demand for data center CPUs to remain strong in 2027 – 2028 as AI infrastructure operators deploy more CPU-intensive agentic and inference workloads.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: To meet demand for Xeon CPUs in the coming years, one of Intel's immediate priorities is to increase output of Xeon 6 'Granite Rapids' processors, which are made using its Intel 3 process technology. The company recently began expanding production capacity at its Fab 24 manufacturing complex near Leixlip, Ireland, but this capacity will only come online by the end of 2027, unless the move can be accelerated.To further increase its Intel 3 capacity, Intel plans to convert some manufacturing resources at its Oregon facilities from Intel 18A to Intel 3. These resources were originally intended to manufacture Panther Lake client processors, but weaker PC demand has allowed Intel to prioritize higher-demand data center products. The company expects the additional Intel 3 capacity in Oregon to enter production in the second half of 2027. You may like Nvidia is bankrolling AI accelerator supply chain buildout to reserve production capacity Desktop CPU shipments crater 20% amid high component costs, but AMD gains record share despite 'ugly' desktop processor market Intel confirms Nova Lake CPUs will use advanced 18A-P node, more details at CES "What we are taking offline to put Intel 3 into Oregon is 18A wafers, which we are generally going to build Panther Lake products," said Dave Zinsner, chief financial officer of Intel. "We see the opportunity with some of that capacity freed up to go produce more data center wafers."Granite Rapids has already become Intel's fastest ramping server processor family, but demand continues to exceed available supply, according to the company's management. Intel is also improving manufacturing yields and reducing production cycle times to extract more usable processors from its existing capacity. According to the company, Intel 3 manufacturing costs have declined by approximately 15% since the first quarter of 2026.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsPrepping for Diamond Rapids, Nova LakeIntel is also accelerating the expansion of its leading-edge manufacturing operations in Arizona. The company is ramping Intel 18A production at Fab 52 and is accelerating equipment installation into the adjacent Fab 62, which is set to become the company's second high-volume manufacturing facility for 18A, 18A-P, and derivative process technologies.These investments will support future Intel 18A/18A-P-based products, including server CPUs, although the company has not disclosed the precise allocation of manufacturing capacity between client and data center products at the facility. While the latter is natural, Intel said during the conference call that it expects to win some market share in the client space with its Core Ultra 400-series 'Nova Lake' CPUs, which will require the company to produce these parts in high volumes.To support its capacity expansion, Intel aggressively procured new tools in the third quarter. What to read next Intel reportedly set to hike CPU prices by 10% ahead of 'major annual product' launch in March 2027 Deadly Intel Fab 28 explosion causes two-week shutdown, to cost $600 million and severely disrupt server chip manufacturing for six months ASML struggling to keep up with demand for chipmaking equipment as AI spending continues to boom Not only wafersWhile expanding production of Intel 3 and Intel 18A/18A-P wafers is a must to increase output of data center CPUs, producing more wafers will not necessarily solve Intel's supply problems. The company also faces shortages of advanced organic substrates required to package its multi-chiplet processors (or rather system-in-packages, or SiPs?) that rely on EMIB and/or Foveros 3D packaging technologies. Intel has been working with substrate suppliers to expand their production capacity and expects approximately 40% additional substrate capacity to become available in the second half of 2027."We are not only constrained on the wafer side, we are also constrained on the substrate side," Zinsner said. "So, it is important we get the substrate piece of this ramped up to be able to meet the demand."In addition, Intel is expanding its advanced packaging operations in New Mexico and Malaysia to support growing demand from internal product groups and external customers. The company already uses its EMIB technology to connect multiple compute dies in Granite Rapids processors, while its newer Clearwater Forest Xeons combine EMIB with Foveros Direct 3D and hybrid bonding to stack Intel 18A compute dies on Intel 3 base dies. Additional packaging capacity will be essential as Intel increases production of these processors and introduces more complex multi-die products as well as assembles advanced system-in-packages using EMIB, EMIB-T, Foveros 3D, and other technologies for external clients."On Advanced Packaging, we are pleased by the progress we are making with EMIB and EMIB-T for our internal products," Tan said. "Both continue to see significant external customer traction as well. We continue to improve on execution, working with our supply chain to secure the capacity to meet the needs of our Advanced Packaging customers. We are also seeing robust progress in the readiness of Hybrid Bonding Interconnect (HBI), which is an enabler of 3D chip stacking for our upcoming server products."Capital neededIntel's expansions will require substantial capital. Intel expects its capital expenditure (CapEx) budget to reach approximately $20 billion in 2026 and increase significantly in 2027 (though it did not reveal any firm numbers). The company said firm purchase orders to semiconductor equipment suppliers increased by nearly 40% sequentially as it secured tools for its manufacturing expansion. Intel is also evaluating opportunities to accelerate construction of its semiconductor manufacturing complex in Ohio, where the first major structural truss was recently installed."We have made good progress securing the equipment required to support our growth plans with firm purchase orders to equipment suppliers increasing nearly 40% sequentially," Zinsner said. "We are also accelerating clean room build-outs, including Fab 62 in Arizona and exploring opportunities to accelerate in Ohio.Yet Intel's capacity expansion will take time to produce results. New equipment must be installed and qualified, additional wafers must pass through lengthy manufacturing cycles, and substrate suppliers must increase their output (which will likely require them to procure new tools and install them) before Intel can ship more finished processors. Consequently, the company expects supply constraints to remain particularly severe during the first half of 2027, even as the client PC market is set to continue contracting.Nevertheless, Intel expects its data center business to continue growing and believes that additional manufacturing capacity, higher yields, and improved substrate availability will enable it to capitalize on demand for AI infrastructure in the second half of 2027 and beyond. history.author: Anton Shilov
history.titleZh: 面对“前所未有的”AI需求，英特尔将产能从消费级CPU转向服务器CPU
history.descriptionZh:
尽管消费级PC市场正在萎缩，且预计未来几个季度仍将收缩，Intel正把部分产能从客户端产品转向数据中心CPU，以应对AI行业对“一切可计算或存储数据”能力的压倒性需求。Intel CEO陈立武（Lip-Bu Tan）在财报电话会上表示，行业正经历历史上最严重的供应短缺之一，背后是“超级智能”需求空前高涨；公司对第三季度服务器供应增长感到满意，但也清楚未来几个季度要跟上服务器需求仍面临挑战。Intel数据中心与AI业务（DCAI）2026年第三季度营收为73亿美元，环比增长17%，同比增长近80%。公司预计，随着AI基础设施运营商部署更多CPU密集型的智能体（agentic）和推理工作负载，2027至2028年数据中心CPU需求仍将强劲。

为增加Xeon供应，Intel的近期重点是扩大基于Intel 3制程的Xeon 6“Granite Rapids”处理器产量。Granite Rapids已成为Intel爬坡最快的服务器处理器家族，但需求仍超过供应。公司已开始扩建爱尔兰Leixlip附近的Fab 24制造园区，但新增产能要到2027年底才能上线，除非能够加速。为进一步增加Intel 3产能，Intel计划把俄勒冈工厂部分原本用于Intel 18A的资源转为Intel 3；这些资源原计划生产Panther Lake客户端处理器，但PC需求疲软使Intel可以优先满足需求更高的数据中心产品。俄勒冈新增Intel 3产能预计2027年下半年投产。CFO Dave Zinsner表示，被腾出用于俄勒冈Intel 3产能的是原本生产Panther Lake的18A晶圆产能。Intel还通过提升良率和缩短生产周期来从现有产能中挤出更多可用处理器；自2026年第一季度以来，Intel 3制造成本已下降约15%。

先进制程扩产方面，Intel正在亚利桑那Fab 52爬坡Intel 18A生产，并加速相邻Fab 62的设备安装。Fab 62将成为Intel第二个高量产18A、18A-P及衍生制程技术的基地，支持包括未来服务器CPU在内的18A/18A-P产品，但公司未披露该厂客户端与数据中心产品的具体产能分配。Intel还表示，希望借助Core Ultra 400系列“Nova Lake”CPU在客户端市场赢得部分份额，这需要高量产支持。为支撑扩产，Intel第三季度大举采购新设备；公司预计2026年资本开支约200亿美元，2027年将显著增加，但未公布具体数字。对半导体设备供应商的确定采购订单环比增长近40%，公司还在评估加速俄亥俄州半导体制造园区建设的机会。

扩产并不只受晶圆产能限制。Intel多芯片小芯片处理器或系统级封装（SiP）依赖EMIB和/或Foveros 3D封装技术，需要先进有机基板。Zinsner称，公司不仅受晶圆端约束，也受基板端约束，因此提升基板供应很重要。Intel正与基板供应商合作扩产，预计2027年下半年将新增约40%基板产能。同时，Intel正在新墨西哥和马来西亚扩大先进封装业务，以支持内部产品团队和外部客户增长。Granite Rapids已使用EMIB连接多个计算die；较新的Clearwater Forest Xeon则把EMIB与Foveros Direct 3D和混合键合结合，将Intel 18A计算die堆叠在Intel 3基础die上。随着Intel提高这些处理器产量、推出更复杂的多die产品，并为外部客户组装基于EMIB、EMIB-T、Foveros 3D等技术的先进系统级封装，额外封装产能至关重要。陈立武表示，EMIB和EMIB-T在内部产品上进展良好，对外部客户也继续保持显著吸引力；混合键合互连（HBI）的准备程度也稳步推进，这是未来服务器产品实现3D芯片堆叠的关键使能技术。

这些扩产需要大量资本，也需要时间才能产生结果：新设备必须安装和验证，新增晶圆要经过漫长制造周期，基板供应商也需采购和安装新设备才能提高产出。因此，Intel预计2027年上半年供应约束仍将特别严重，即使客户端PC市场继续收缩。不过，Intel仍预计数据中心业务将继续增长，并认为新增制造产能、更高良率和基板供应改善，将使其在2027年下半年及以后更好地把握AI基础设施需求。

history.title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
history.description:
Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, the company announced on its Chinese newsroom website, as reported by MacRumors. The Apple Intelligence features will be available first in an iOS 27.3 beta that's set to launch on November 4th, with a full iOS 27.3 release scheduled for December.
This launch doesn't bring the new Siri AI to China. Instead, Apple is launching several of its earlier Apple Intelligence features like notification summaries, real-time translation, rewriting and proofreading tools, visual intelligence, and removing objects from photos. Apple also says it has worked with Ailbaba to add support for its Q …
Read the full story at The Verge.
history.content: Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, the company announced on its Chinese newsroom website, as reported by MacRumors. The Apple Intelligence features will be available first in an iOS 27.3 beta that’s set to launch on November 4th, with a full iOS 27.3 release scheduled for December.This launch doesn’t bring the new Siri AI to China. Instead, Apple is launching several of its earlier Apple Intelligence features like notification summaries, real-time translation, rewriting and proofreading tools, visual intelligence, and removing objects from photos. Apple also says it has worked with Ailbaba to add support for its Qwen chatbot in some experiences, which sounds similar to iOS’s integration with OpenAI’s ChatGPT that launched in 2024.Apple Intelligence was approved in China in July, which signalled that the launch of the AI tools was getting near. Apple trained its own LLM specifically for China, Reuters reported in August.
history.author: Jay Peters
history.descriptionZh:
苹果已在其中国官网新闻室宣布，Apple Intelligence 将随 iOS 27.3 登陆中国。据 MacRumors 报道，首批 Apple Intelligence 功能会先在计划于 11 月 4 日发布的 iOS 27.3 测试版中提供，正式版 iOS 27.3 则计划于 12 月推出。此次上线并不包含新的 Siri AI，而是先落地苹果此前已推出的一组 Apple Intelligence 功能，包括通知摘要、实时翻译、改写与校对工具、视觉智能，以及从照片中移除物体等。

在中国版 Apple Intelligence 的落地方案上，苹果表示已与阿里巴巴合作，在某些体验中加入对其通义千问（Qwen）聊天机器人的支持。这一集成方式听起来类似 iOS 在 2024 年与 OpenAI ChatGPT 的整合，即由本地合作伙伴的大模型为部分 AI 体验提供能力支持。原文未具体说明 Qwen 接入哪些功能、调用边界如何，也未披露模型规模、响应时延、准确率等性能参数，因此目前无法进行具体的量化对比。可确认的对比主要是功能范围：中国首发版本覆盖较早一批 Apple Intelligence 能力，但不包含新的 Siri AI；Qwen 的集成定位则与 ChatGPT 在 iOS 中的合作模式相似。

背景方面，Apple Intelligence 已于今年 7 月在中国获批，这被视为相关 AI 工具临近上线的信号。路透社 8 月报道称，苹果还专门为中国训练了自有大语言模型。结合这两点看，中国版 Apple Intelligence 可能采取“自研本地模型＋本地合作伙伴模型”的组合路线：一方面通过专门训练的自有 LLM 适配中国市场，另一方面引入阿里 Qwen 为部分体验补充大模型能力。这种安排既延续 Apple Intelligence 端侧与云端协同的总体思路，也体现出针对中国监管环境和本地生态进行适配的策略。其创新点更多在于落地与合规路径，而非全新功能形态：先上线通知摘要、翻译、写作辅助、视觉识别和图像编辑等成熟度较高的功能，暂缓新 Siri AI，有助于降低初期合规与体验风险。

从应用场景看，这批功能可覆盖通知信息降噪、跨语言沟通、文本改写与校对、视觉信息理解以及照片对象移除等日常需求，提升 iPhone 在中国市场的 AI 可用性和本土化体验。技术影响上，苹果专门为中国训练 LLM 并与阿里 Qwen 合作，意味着国际终端厂商在华落地生成式 AI 时，可能更普遍采用本地模型与本地生态合作并行的模式。不过，苹果尚未公布具体支持机型、完整功能清单、Qwen 的具体接入范围以及新 Siri AI 后续入华时间表，相关性能与体验表现仍需等待测试版和正式版上线后验证。

history.content: Asked about supply chain shortages, like the ongoing RAM shortage, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in an interview that it’s “terrible” to have RAM in personal PCs instead of data centers. During his appearance on the Cheeky Pint podcast, where he also commented on AI’s impact on math, Altman said:“A lot of people want local inference. And somehow, they assume that the problem is solved now because we are going to have open-source models, we’re going to be able to run them on our computers, and so we’re not going to need all the stuff in the data center.But from a global allocation perspective, actually, it’s quite terrible to have everybody have a bunch of the world’s limited supply of DRAM sitting in their own computer and being used five percent of the time.You want maximum utilization in the cloud if you’re trying to deal with this very supply constrained environment. And somehow everyone’s— many people’s intuition is the opposite of that.”Whether Altman meant your gaming PC or developers working with something like the Surface RTX Spark Dev Box or the new touchscreen MacBook Pro, the outcome is the same. Right now, memory companies Samsung and SK Hynix have long term deals with cloud service operators and projects like OpenAI’s Stargate that have reserved much of the world’s RAM output over the next few years. And the billions they’re willing to lay out for chips is why the laptops, phones, and other tech you use are getting more expensive right now.
history.author: Stevie Bonifield
history.titleZh: 萨姆·奥尔特曼表示，内存放在数据中心比放在你的桌面上更好。
history.descriptionZh:
OpenAI CEO萨姆·奥尔特曼在参加Cheeky Pint播客时，被问及供应链短缺（包括持续的内存短缺）问题。他表示，把RAM放在个人PC里而不是数据中心是“糟糕的”。在播客中，他还谈到AI对数学的影响。奥尔特曼说：“很多人想要本地推理。不知何故，他们假设问题已经解决，因为我们将拥有开源模型，能够在自己电脑上运行，因此不再需要数据中心里的所有东西。但从全球分配的角度看，让每个人把世界上有限的DRAM供应中的一部分放在自己电脑里，而且只使用5%的时间，实际上相当糟糕。如果你要应对这种供应非常受限的环境，你希望云端实现最大利用率。而不知何故，每个人——很多人的直觉却相反。”

无论奥尔特曼指的是游戏PC，还是开发者使用的Surface RTX Spark Dev Box或新款触摸屏MacBook Pro等设备，结果都一样。目前，内存厂商三星和SK海力士已与云服务运营商以及OpenAI的Stargate等项目签订长期协议，预留了未来几年全球大部分RAM产出。他们愿意为芯片投入数十亿美元，这也是当前笔记本电脑、手机和其他科技产品变得越来越贵的原因。

从技术路线看，这一表态涉及本地推理与云端推理的权衡。本地推理指在个人电脑、手机或开发设备上直接运行开源模型，优点是隐私、低延迟和离线可用；但在内存供应紧张的背景下，每台设备都要配备大量DRAM，而实际使用率可能只有5%，会造成全球稀缺内存资源的低效分散。云端推理则把模型运行集中在数据中心，通过集中调度提高GPU、内存和存储的利用率，在供应受限时更有利于最大化有限DRAM的产出效率。奥尔特曼的观点并非否定本地推理，而是强调从全球资源分配看，把大量内存放在使用率很低的个人设备上并不合理。

原文没有给出具体性能参数或跑分对比，但提供了几个关键量化信息：个人设备中的DRAM可能仅被使用5%的时间；三星和SK海力士的长期协议覆盖未来几年全球大部分RAM产出；云厂商和Stargate等项目愿意投入数十亿美元锁定芯片产能。这些因素共同导致消费电子成本上升。其影响在于，AI推理需求增长正在重塑内存供应链：云服务商和大型AI项目优先获得产能，个人PC、手机等终端面临更贵的内存和更高的本地AI硬件门槛。应用场景上，云端推理适合大规模模型服务和供应紧张环境下的资源集中利用；本地推理仍适合隐私敏感、离线或低延迟场景，但需要权衡内存成本与利用率。
